scope: 15 access-route entries across 13 providers. Dated supplement; does not renumber or alter recovered Rabbit originals.
status: Documentation review and proposed workflow; no bulk collection, ongoing monitor, purchase, signup or outreach.

entries.name: Public Job Board API
entries.authentication: GET; no authentication for public reads.
entries.coverage: All published posts for a known board; JSON includes full descriptions with content=true. No cross-employer directory or historical archive documented.
entries.bulk_or_pagination: One full board response; check meta.total. Do not invent pagination parameters.
entries.identifiers_dates: Posting id; internal_job_id; requisition_id when present; updated_at.
entries.cost_terms: No API charge stated for public GET. No numeric read quota verified. Review employer terms and content reuse before a repeated collection.
entries.verification: One Anduril job endpoint could not be retrieved through the web tool; documentation verified, payload not verified.
entries.cautions: Retain posting and internal job IDs separately. Null internal_job_id may be a prospect post. updated_at is not initial publication. Public API access does not grant blanket republication rights.

entries.name: Public Postings API
entries.authentication: GET; public posting read route. EU base: https://api.eu.lever.co/v0/postings/.
entries.coverage: Published jobs for a known employer; descriptions, requirements lists, locations, departments and hosted URLs. No global full-text search or historical archive.
entries.bulk_or_pagination: Use skip and limit until exhausted; search descriptions locally.
entries.identifiers_dates: id; hostedUrl; categories; descriptionPlain; lists; additionalPlain.
entries.cost_terms: No API charge or numeric GET quota verified. Review applicable employer/vendor terms before repeated collection.
entries.verification: A Palantir limit=1 request could not be retrieved through the web tool; documentation verified, payload not verified.
entries.cautions: Do not apply application-submission POST limits to GET reads. Preserve separate text fields; do not invent a posting date when absent.

entries.name: Public Job Postings API
entries.authentication: Public GET example requires no credential.
entries.coverage: Currently published postings for one known board, with descriptions, team, locations, employment type and optional compensation.
entries.bulk_or_pagination: All published postings in jobs array; no pagination documented on this page.
entries.cost_terms: No price or numeric quota verified for this public endpoint. Review employer terms and storage/reuse rights.
entries.cautions: Exclude isListed=false from general indexing: it denotes direct-link-only postings. publishedAt means last publication. isRemote also covers hybrid; use workplaceType.

entries.name: Dedicated Partner Job Feed
entries.authentication: Partner onboarding and employer opt-in required; no request submitted.
entries.coverage: Participating customers' published jobs in flat JSON or XML; includes organization IDs, posting IDs, descriptions, publishedAt and updatedAt.
entries.bulk_or_pagination: Provider says refreshed hourly. Retrieve contracted feed and deduplicate by organizationId plus id.
entries.cost_terms: Price, quota, retention and journalism/republication rights require agreement; not an open all-Ashby dump.
entries.verification: Documentation reviewed; no partnership or feed access.
entries.cautions: Employer opt-in creates coverage gaps; same data is offered in JSON and XML. Do not count the two formats as independent sources.
endpoints: Provider-provisioned dedicated feed; no public universal URL.

entries.name: Public Posting API
entries.authentication: Public GET example in docs; restrict to public postings. Never use internal_postings_read or employer credentials for this catalog workflow.
entries.coverage: Active company postings; q and location/department filters; list may omit description fields.
entries.bulk_or_pagination: Page limit/offset against totalFound; follow each item's ref for full object.
entries.cost_terms: No price/numeric read quota verified. Check public-only response and employer terms before pilot.
entries.cautions: Current overview also describes credentials exposing internal postings. Do not confuse that privileged capability with the public feed or request access to it.

entries.name: Historic JOA and Announcement Text APIs
entries.authentication: Both GET endpoints explicitly require no authentication.
entries.coverage: US federal current and past announcements: compact metadata plus a separate long-text bulk route. Does not cover most contractor hiring.
entries.bulk_or_pagination: Filter date windows and agency/department/series; follow paging.next/continuationToken until exhausted. Join the two outputs by usajobsControlNumber.
entries.cost_terms: Public endpoints; no charge stated. Review USAJOBS public-data terms and preserve collection conditions.
entries.verification: Official documentation reviewed; no payload test or bulk download.
entries.cautions: Do not apply Search API's 10,000-row ceiling to HistoricJoa without evidence. Closing date is not a confirmed hire date. Verify historical completeness and later revisions before a backtest.

entries.name: Current Search API
entries.authentication: Registered API key required; no registration or key created.
entries.coverage: Search currently open federal announcements using keywords and structured filters; complements historical bulk endpoints.
entries.bulk_or_pagination: Explicit ResultsPerPage up to 500; Page pagination; documented ceiling 10,000 rows per query.
entries.identifiers_dates: PositionID; PositionURI; organization; opening/closing dates; matching object identifiers.
entries.cost_terms: No price stated; quotas/terms apply. Query ceiling is a result limit, not an exhaustive universe.
entries.cautions: Use date/agency partitions and record completeness if approaching ceiling. Prefer historical bulk for large archival extracts.

entries.name: Swedish Platsbanken historical files and JobStream
entries.authentication: Public historical downloads; JobStream explicitly needs no API key or registration.
entries.coverage: Swedish Platsbanken bulk history from 2006; annual/quarterly JSONL archives. JobStream supports current ads and publication, update and removal changes.
entries.bulk_or_pagination: Start with the required historical files or current snapshot, then consume JobStream changes. Select production endpoints from linked current API docs.
entries.identifiers_dates: Preserve ad identifier, employer, location, publication/update/removal times and original language.
entries.cost_terms: Official dataset and service list CC0. Privacy obligations remain; omit contact-person data from public research outputs.
entries.verification: Official metadata and file index checked; archives not downloaded; stream not executed.
entries.cautions: Historical search API begins in 2016 and requires unpublished ads; it is not equivalent to bulk files from 2006. Platsbanken is not a census of Swedish hiring. Do not combine patched/original copies as extra ads.

entries.name: Cleared-sector job board
entries.authentication: No public read API or bulk export located in this bounded documentation search.
entries.coverage: Highly relevant specialist discovery source for clearance-required hiring. Automated mass collection is not cleared.
entries.bulk_or_pagination: No authorized export pagination established; do not build a scraper.
entries.identifiers_dates: Any future licensed export should retain job ID, employer, source URL, description and dates.
entries.cost_terms: Terms section 8.2(aa) restrict automated retrieval/indexing/data mining; 8.2(j) restrict tools; 8.2(k) addresses AI use; 2.1 restricts republication.
entries.verification: Terms and employer product documentation reviewed; no data collected.
entries.cautions: Employer job-upload/syndication products do not establish permission to download the whole board. Obtain written terms for research, full text, history and derived analysis before mass collection.

entries.name: Cleared-sector job board
entries.authentication: No public read API or bulk export located in this bounded documentation search.
entries.coverage: Specialist cleared-employment discovery; useful potential licensed coverage alongside employer feeds.
entries.identifiers_dates: Request stable ad IDs, source links, employer, description, dates and change records if licensing becomes available.
entries.cost_terms: Site Terms prohibit aggregating/copying/duplicating materials; general download permission is personal noncommercial single-copy use.
entries.verification: Official terms and search guidance reviewed; no data collected.
entries.cautions: Search and alert features are not bulk-data permission. Avoid applicant/profile data; use a negotiated employer-ad feed only if authorized.

entries.name: Job Search API
entries.authentication: app_id and app_key required; no signup completed.
entries.coverage: Country-specific search by terms and filters. Description response is a snippet, so important defense/AI language may be missing.
entries.bulk_or_pagination: Page path plus results_per_page. Current limits are account-specific; do not assume historical fixed quotas.
entries.identifiers_dates: id; created; company.display_name; title; redirect_url; salary_is_predicted.
entries.cost_terms: Free key is evaluation access. Ongoing organizational research needs written consent/licensing beyond the 14-day evaluation; attribution required.
entries.verification: Official API and current terms reviewed; no authenticated test.
entries.cautions: Historical salary endpoints do not establish historical full-ad access. Keep predicted salary distinct from employer-stated pay.

entries.name: Custom feeds and historical RAW data
entries.authentication: Commercial arrangement required; no quote or account requested.
entries.coverage: Employer-site postings. Custom feeds supply full-text active job descriptions; historical RAW offering is separate and should be scoped explicitly.
entries.bulk_or_pagination: Daily full and differential CSV/XML/JSON feeds; confirm historical delivery and change semantics in contract.
entries.identifiers_dates: Request stable posting/company IDs, original URLs, first/last-seen and content-change dates.
entries.cost_terms: No public fixed research price or redistribution license verified. Contract must cover full text, historical versions, quoted evidence and derived publication.
entries.verification: Official product documentation reviewed; no sample purchased or downloaded.
entries.cautions: Provider coverage claims are not measured completeness for defense contractors. Obtain employer/date coverage sample before purchase.
endpoints: Provider-delivered feeds via agreed channel, including FTP or AWS S3.

entries.name: Global Job Postings API
entries.authentication: OAuth bearer token with postings:global scope; no credentials requested.
entries.coverage: Individual postings and filtering by company, skills, geography and time; response can include body and source URL.
entries.bulk_or_pagination: POST query with filter/fields and licensed pagination; default documented 5 requests/second. Confirm accessible result ceiling before export.
entries.identifiers_dates: id; posted; expired; body; company_name; title_raw; url.
entries.cost_terms: Commercial entitlement required; no fixed price or publication rights verified.
entries.verification: Official documentation reviewed; no payload test.
entries.cautions: URL is available only for active postings in this endpoint. Confirm historical source provenance and full-text rights. Company API is a separate raw employer-source dataset, not equivalent to deduplicated Global.

entries.name: Jobs API and Bulk Collect
entries.authentication: API key and suitable credits/plan required; no account created.
entries.coverage: Structured current/historical job-data product; bulk process returns prepared JSON.gz files after a query request.
entries.bulk_or_pagination: Check request files/status, then download approved files; documented file maximum 10,000 JSON records and 30-day download window. Confirm query limits for chosen product.
entries.identifiers_dates: Request provider ID, employer, original source URL, description and first/last/update dates.
entries.cost_terms: Credit/contract based; price and rights for intended research not verified.
entries.verification: Official product/bulk documentation reviewed; no request submitted.
entries.cautions: Do not conflate a record snapshot with a complete change history or use employee-profile products. Check source provenance, coverage and redistribution rights before licensing.

entries.name: Research microdata API or secure files
entries.authentication: Application approval, data-use agreement and named authorized users required.
entries.coverage: Daily/historical US job microdata with descriptions. Potential research source, not open public export.
entries.bulk_or_pagination: API or secure-server files by agreement; current new-request processing paused during transition to a 2027 model.
entries.identifiers_dates: Request job/source/employer IDs, original description, dates and provenance.
entries.cost_terms: Published policy limits current authorized uses, disallows third-party raw sharing and identifiable postings in published outputs; contract scope matters.
entries.verification: Official access notice reviewed 2026-11-09; no request submitted.
entries.cautions: Existing users and pending requests are unaffected by pause. Recheck in 2027; source-identifying journalism may conflict with current aggregation/confidentiality terms.
endpoints: Access route supplied to approved users under data agreement.
